research_rationale:
basis_pattern: original_plus_bounded_search. EO 12908 (signed 1994-04-22; 59 FR 21907; official Federal Register text jobs/fr-originals/data/full_run/texts/EO_12908.txt, read in full) prescribes the order in which officers act as Secretary of the Army on the Secretary's death, permanent disability, resignation, absence or temporary disability. Identity: the Title 3 heading of Executive Order 12908 of April 22, 1994, on the order of succession of officers to act as Secretary of the Army at 59 FR 21907, the title and the date agree with the register row. The dossier inventory has ten clauses (the section 1 heading and paragraphs (a), (a)(1) to (3), (b), (b)(1), (b)(2), (c) and (d)); I confirmed it without correction. Own terms: no clause has an end date or ending condition. Later instruments: a search of every held order text for the number 12908 finds only the order's own Federal Register copy and the Federal Register table of contents of 1994 that lists it; the dossier chain has no event and lists no actor. No held text revokes, supersedes or amends it. The three selected machine searches (current-law:usc, current-law:ecfr, later-events:ofr_catalog) were read with their coverage notes, carry no coverage warning, and record 0, 0 and 0 hits for the order number respectively. Limit stated plainly: the continuing predicate rests on the held original text and the bounded searches (U.S. Code through 2026-10-09), which record 0 hits; the order recites no statutory authority and the statutes on the Army's succession and the Vacancies Act are not held, so no statutory change is ruled out beyond the absence of any held ending instrument.
